title: Per-section accent theme variants with scoped CSS token overrides

requirements.summary: Introduce per-section theming via scoped CSS variable overrides so each major section gets its own accent while keeping a cohesive global theme and RTL unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Each major section (overview, energy-types, citizenship, relationship, algeria, simulators, videos, conclusion) displays a noticeably different accent color than adjacent sections.

The change is implemented via scoped CSS variable overrides (e.g., local overrides for theme tokens like --primary/--ring) so existing components that use theme tokens (e.g., text-primary, bg-primary, accent-primary) automatically inherit the section accent.
Light and dark mode both have appropriate section accent variants with readable contrast.
RTL layout, spacing, and typography are not broken or flipped by the changes.

file_operations.description: Add scoped per-section theme variant selectors (classes or data-attributes) that locally override theme tokens (at least --primary, --primary-foreground, --ring; optionally also --accent/--accent-foreground and subtle --card tint) while leaving global tokens intact. Include dark-mode equivalents. Ensure overrides are subtree-scoped so components using Tailwind theme tokens automatically inherit per section.

Assign a distinct section theme variant to each major section instance (overview, energy-types, citizenship, relationship, algeria, simulators, videos, conclusion) by passing a theme wrapper class/data-attribute to section components/instances, ensuring adjacent sections differ and scroll/RTL behavior remains unchanged.

requirements.summary: Define a small maintainable palette (6–8) of section theme variant classes in frontend/src/index.css with light/dark overrides for key theme tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/index.css contains clearly named section theme classes (or data-attribute selectors) that can be applied to a wrapper element to change the section accent color.
The variants include both light and dark overrides (e.g., via .dark .section-theme-* or equivalent), and all remain consistent with the app’s overall theme style.
No global theme tokens are removed; this only adds scoped overrides.

file_operations.description: Create 6–8 clearly named section theme variant selectors (e.g., .section-theme-sky, .section-theme-emerald, etc.) that override --primary, --primary-foreground, --ring (and optionally --accent/--accent-foreground and a subtle --card tint) for the subtree. Add matching dark-mode overrides using .dark .section-theme-* (or equivalent). Keep existing global theme tokens and RTL base styles unchanged.

requirements.summary: Apply section theme variants to existing sections so cards/panels and DecoratedHeading automatically reflect each section’s assigned accent without hard-coded colors.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/sections/MainContent.tsx and each relevant section component apply a section theme wrapper (class or data attribute) per section instance.
DecoratedHeading (frontend/src/components/DecoratedHeading.tsx) continues to use theme tokens (e.g., primary) and therefore changes appearance per section without introducing hard-coded colors.
Components inside sections that rely on primary styling (e.g., buttons/selection states, simulator accent bars, etc.) visually match the section accent after the wrapper is applied.
No section content text is changed; only styling/appearance is updated.

file_operations.description: Add an optional prop (e.g., themeClass/themeVariant) and apply it to the outer <section> (or a wrapper) so the section subtree receives the scoped CSS token overrides. Ensure highlight styling continues to reference theme tokens (bg-primary/border-primary) so it adapts per section. Do not change any content rendering or RTL-related classes.

Accept an optional theme wrapper prop and apply it to the outer <section> so all internal elements using primary/accent tokens (selected states, headings, etc.) inherit the per-section accent automatically. Keep existing structure/RTL classes and text unchanged.

Accept an optional theme wrapper prop and apply it to the outer <section> so simulator selector states and SimulatorPanel styling that rely on primary/accent tokens reflect the section accent. Keep RTL behavior and content unchanged.
Accept an optional theme wrapper prop and apply it to the outer <section> so DecoratedHeading and card styling inherit the section accent via tokens. Keep RTL behavior and text unchanged.

Verify DecoratedHeading continues to use theme tokens (bg-primary/text-primary/gradient from-primary) without introducing hard-coded colors, so it automatically updates per section when wrapped by a theme variant. Keep layout/RTL-safe flex behavior unchanged.

Wire the per-section theme variants by passing the chosen theme wrapper prop to each ReportSection and to EnergyTypesSection/SimulatorsSection/VideosSection so every major section gets a distinct variant and adjacent sections differ. Ensure no section text content changes.
